entities.summary: Anna Christina Nobre FBA, MAE, fNASc is a Brazilian and British cognitive neuroscientist. She is the Wu Tsai Professor at Yale University. She is an honorary member of the Departments of Psychiatry and Experimental Psychology at the University of Oxford; an honorary fellow of New College, Oxford; and an adjunct professor at the Mesulam Center for Cognitive Neurology and Alzheimer's Disease at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine.
